{{Quote|Renegade Flight, this is Renegade Leader, prepare to engage the TIE Fighters.|Commander Narra|<ref name="Freedom's Winter">{{ESBRadio|Freedom's Winter}}</ref>}}
'''Arhul Narra''' was the [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] group [[Renegade Flight]] in the early years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He later assumed control of [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which included his former unit and a new group known as [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Flight]]. After his death at the [[Battle of Derra IV]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] of Rogue Flight was promoted to the rank of Commander and took control of Red Squadron, which he soon after molded into Rogue Squadron.

==Biography==
Arhul Narra was a veteran of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], having served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the conflict. With the onset of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Narra joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

Narra served as [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] group [[Renegade Flight]] early in the war. [[Pilot/Legends|Pilots]] who served under him often called him "'''The Boss'''" or shortened his name to "'''Narr'''." He was also the owner of [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[K-3PO/Legends|K-3PO]], used by the Commander to record his memoirs and keep track of various military engagements. Absorbing this information turned the droid into a tactical expert.

Renegade Flight was key to the early Alliance victory at the [[Battle of Ton-Falk]]. An offhand remark K-3PO made to Narra during the battle led to an ingenious strategy that helped win the battle. After [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] [[Garven Dreis/Legends|Garven Dreis]] was killed in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|attack]] on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], Narra assumed control of [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]], though he also retained command of Renegade Flight.

[[File:Narr.jpg|thumb|left|Narra with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]]]
During a [[Battle of Lubang Minor (Galactic Civil War)|mission]] on [[Lubang Minor]] shortly after the Rebel evacuation of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], Narra and members of Red Squadron came under attack from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. Some pilots managed to take off, but Narra and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] did not get to their ships in time and were pursued on foot by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. While on the run in the jungle, the two Rebels found an aged [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] known as [[Able]], who had survived on the planet for years after his ship crashed there during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In order to secure Able's help, Narra encouraged Skywalker to use his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to convince the clone that the young Rebel was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], and referred to him as "General Skywalker." After the Rebels escaped, Narra apologized for deceiving Able, who soon agreed to join the Alliance.

Shortly before the Battle of Hoth, Renegade Flight was destroyed and Narra was killed while escorting a convoy carrying supplies for [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]]. The convoy was near [[Derra IV/Legends|Derra IV]] when it was [[Battle of Derra IV|ambushed]] by an ''Imperial'' Star Destroyer and several squadrons of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] led by [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]]. Every Alliance vessel at the battle was destroyed. After Narra's death, General [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Rieekan]] promoted Luke Skywalker to Commander.

A plaque commemorating the lost pilots of Renegade Flight was hung on the command deck of the Rebel frigate [[Chancellor (frigate)|''Chancellor'']].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Narra.jpg|thumb|Commander Narra]]
The ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', ''[[Who's Who in Rogue Squadron]]'', [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']], and ''[[Star Wars: Rebellion: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' all place Commander Narra and his Renegade Flight at the Battle of Yavin. [[Lucasfilm]]'s [[Leland Chee]] has since confirmed this as an error.<ref name="SWB">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=3000#15740050|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2006-10-05|time=9:45 AM}}</ref>
